rules: Color is function. Monochrome base with high-saturation signal colors (Green/Red) used strictly for profit/loss and active states.
Dense data correlation over negative space. This is a sniper bot, users want max information density on mobile.
Optical clarity is paramount. No soft shadows, no glassmorphism. Hard 1px borders and flat surfaces.
Never use pure black #000000, always use the obsidian base #0A0A0C.
Primary CTA buttons must be Neon Green (#00FF66) with Black text for maximum visibility.
Loss/Rug warnings must use Alert Red (#FF3366).

headings.usage: Screen titles, primary metrics (e.g., SOL Balance)

data_logs.usage: Wallet addresses, token prices, P&L percentages, activity log feeds

rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking) on headings.
Overlines/Labels must be UPPERCASE + tiny + wide spacing.
Never use Inter for headings. Forbidden font: Space Grotesk.
Use flexDirection: 'row' with flexWrap: 'wrap' for bento-style stats.
Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use borderWidth: 1 and borderColor: '#27272A' for data cells to look like a terminal.
No rounded corners greater than 8px. Default to 4px or 0px for a sharp, technical look.

cards.style: Flat background (#121216), 1px solid border (#27272A), 4px border radius. NO shadows.

buttons.primary: Background #00FF66, Text #0A0A0C, 4px radius, font Space Mono Bold.
buttons.interaction: React Native Pressable with scale down to 0.95 or opacity 0.8 on pressIn.

inputs.style: Background #0A0A0C, Border 1px #27272A, padding 12, Text #FFFFFF. Focus state: borderColor #00FF66.

badges.style: Padding 4px 8px, 4px radius, uppercase Space Mono, text size 10. Used for Platform (Pump.fun, Raydium) and Status (Live, Paper).

activity_log.style: Container with #050505 bg, Space Mono text, green for buys, red for sells, white for info. Must look like a CLI terminal output.

icons.rules: Use sharp, geometric icons. Avoid soft, rounded icon sets.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark mode technology background, deep obsidian black with subtle signal green glowing mesh lines. Perfect for login screen or upper header background with an opacity overlay.
Dark blue/black grid texture for empty states or dashboard section backgrounds at low opacity (10%).

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` prop in React Native (equivalent to data-testid). E.g., `testID="sniper-start-button"`.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text on the #0A0A0C background for maximum contrast. Neon green must only have dark text overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. Use standard React Native components (View, Text, Pressable, ScrollView, FlatList) and StyleSheet.create().
Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span) or Tailwind CSS classes directly unless NativeWind is pre-configured.
Map the provided color hex codes directly to StyleSheet objects.
Use @expo-google-fonts for the typography. If loading fonts is complex, fallback to standard system monospace (Platform.select({ ios: 'Courier', android: 'monospace' })).
Implement the 'Activity Log' as a FlatList that auto-scrolls to the bottom, mimicking a CLI terminal.
For the bottom tab navigation, keep the background #0A0A0C with a top border of #27272A. Active tab icon should be #00FF66.
Data density is key. Use small text (12px-14px) in the Scanner and Portfolio views to show more tokens per screen.
Do NOT wrap this output in markdown when parsing.
